description:
Planning only: capture the agreed design; do not implement until requested.

Problem
The shared ChannelConnectorCard Enable/Disable control is reused by ChannelsLive, SMTP, IMAP and web widget pages. WhatsApp disabling must warn that it logs out the selected profile without changing other adapters.

Agreed design
- Keep the shared component provider-agnostic; reuse its existing configurable toggle_event.
- Add a communication UI policy module (proposed Communication.ChannelDisablePolicy) with before_disable(adapter, config), returning :proceed by default or {:confirm, message}.
- WhatsApp requires a dialog: "Disabling WhatsApp will log out this profile. You will need to link it again to reconnect." Buttons: Confirm and Cancel.
- LiveView owns pending confirmation and freezes the selected profile ID. Cancel/dismiss causes no configuration or logout side effects. Enabling remains unchanged.
- Confirm invokes the existing supported service boundary: LiveView -> NodeRouter.dispatch/1 with %Zaq.Event{} -> Channels communication bridge -> Jido chat bridge -> jido_chat_whatsapp logout.
- Verify actual bridge ownership, supported upstream API, and whether current disable already logs out before choosing exact function names. The agreed chain is intended architecture, not yet a verified API trace.
- Reuse existing logout/lifecycle behavior; do not duplicate logout or introduce provider conditions in the shared button.

Action reuse assessment (preliminary; discovery required before implementation)
Evidence: ChannelConnectorCard.toggle_event and ChannelsLive.toggle_active_config already implement shared click routing and configuration/runtime updates. Inspect Channels domain events, communication/Jido bridges and upstream jido_chat_whatsapp for existing logout operations.
Decision: local-only UI policy/dialog; reuse or cohesively extend the canonical channel disable/logout operation through NodeRouter. No agent-tool exposure.
Contract: trusted authenticated actor and selected config/profile identity; confirmation authorizes only disabling that profile. Define stale/deleted/already-disabled handling, duplicate confirmation idempotency, and logout failure/persistence ordering before coding. Report failures without falsely claiming successful logout.
Consumers: BO adapter configuration UI; other adapters retain existing immediate-disable semantics. Domain lifecycle remains service-owned.
If discovery identifies a missing essential composable Action, track its prerequisite per docs/action-reuse.md before implementing consumers.

Acceptance and validation
- WhatsApp Disable opens the warning and performs no mutation before confirmation.
- Cancel/dismiss preserves enabled state and linked session.
- Confirm disables/logs out only the original selected profile through the existing adapter integration.
- Other adapters and WhatsApp enabling retain current behavior.
- Cover confirmation, cancellation, profile targeting, repeated/stale confirmation and operation failures with focused LiveView/service tests.
- Inspect existing test expectations; obtain explicit approval before changing their behavior.
- Assess feature E2E need and reuse existing WhatsApp UX/E2E tracking where appropriate; new feature E2E authoring requires final human UX/UI approval.
- Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle, mix q, isolated tests and final mix precommit.

Before affected work read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/channels.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md and docs/testing-approach.md.
